triples.subject: Markel
triples.quote: And then I remembered my brother Markel and what he said on his death-bed to his servants

triples.subject: Afanasy
triples.quote: He had not long been in my service and I had struck him before, but never with such ferocious cruelty.

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: In the evening, returning home in a savage and brutal humor, I flew into a rage with my orderly Afanasy, and gave him two blows in the face with all my might, so that it was covered with blood.

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: After four years of this life, I chanced to be in the town of K. where our regiment was stationed at the time.

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: I was fond of reading, yet strange to say, the Bible was the one book I never opened at that time, though I always carried it about with me, and I was never separated from it;

triples.subject: Afanasy
triples.quote: I had moved into her rooms simply because on my return from the duel I had sent Afanasy back to the regiment, as I felt ashamed to look him in the face after my last interview with him.

triples.subject: Pyotr
triples.quote: A serf of hers called Pyotr was at once suspected, and every circumstance confirmed the suspicion.
